name: Goodwood Barbecue Company (Draper) Slow-Smoked Turkey Breast or Rotisserie Chicken & Baked Idaho Potato
whyItWorks: Right down the street from TownePlace Suites Draper, Goodwood BBQ slow-smokes lean turkey breast and spit-roasts herb chicken; paired with a hot baked Idaho potato (eat the fluffy inside) and warm dinner roll, it is a very safe sit-down meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hickory-Smoked Turkey Breast or Rotisserie Chicken (remove the skin, BBQ sauce on the side) with a plain Baked Potato (butter on the side) and skip the house salad/coleslaw.
watchOuts: Leave the baked potato skin behind and skip BBQ baked beans and raw slaw
